english.note: This is the all-purpose choice for a formal religious ceremony or ritual.
This is the all-purpose choice for a rite or a repeated set of actions, especially in a religious context.
This is the all-purpose choice for a ritual and for a ceremony in general, especially when the focus is on the actions or ritual itself.
